title: Plugin manifest (plugin.json)

id.title: Plugin id
id.description: Unique on the instance, and the name of the plugin folder. Do not change it once tables use the plugin.

name.description: The name admins and GMs see.

kind.description: Only game systems exist for now.

coreApi.description: The core API versions the plugin works with, as a semver range such as `^0.1.0`. A server outside the range lists the plugin as unusable.

description.description: Shown on the plugin admin page.

hasCode.description: True exactly when the plugin has a `code/` folder. Admins must acknowledge code before enabling the plugin.

locales.description: The languages in `lang/`. Each needs its `lang/<locale>.json`.

defaultLocale.description: The language whose text shows when the viewer's language lacks a key; one of `locales`. Defaults to the first of `locales`, then `en`.
defaultLocale.title: Locale

description: The plugin manifest. Every plugin has one, at the root of its folder.
